thread:
maria: FYI, found a flaky onboarding repro in the Node sampleapp where request-id is different between logs and traces when debug logging is enabled. seems like an init ordering / bootstrap race between retry wrapper and otel/sdk init. repro below.

maria: Repro steps (local):
```bash
git clone github.com/redwood/sampleapp.git
cd sampleapp/examples/node
npm ci
REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=debug node server.js
# curl -v http://localhost:3000/chat (have retries enabled in the client)
```
Observed: server log shows initial request-id on incoming request, retry wrapper emits a new request-id when retrying, but the span starts with the old id and then the SDK reconciles later. results in log request-id != trace request-id which confuses onboarding users.

liam: can you paste the exact log lines and package versions? we'll triage and escalate to sdk folks. does this show up on node 18 and 20?

maria: log snippet:
```
[2026-03-03T09:12:01.001Z] INFO  server  <-- incoming request { path: "/chat", request-id: "rid-init-111" }
[2026-03-03T09:12:01.004Z] DEBUG retry   retrying, assigning request-id: "rid-retry-222"
[2026-03-03T09:12:01.005Z] DEBUG otel    span.start trace=trace-aaa request-id=rid-init-111
[2026-03-03T09:12:01.010Z] DEBUG sdk     init complete, reconciled request-id -> rid-retry-222
```
Packages: redwood-telemetry@0.9.2, redwood-sdk@1.4.0, @opentelemetry/api@1.0.3, node v20.1.0

anjali: ive seen this pattern before. the SDK has a deferred path at debug log level to enable extra hooks; that deferral can miss copying a temporary header set by middleware earlier in bootstrap. the retry wrapper in sampleapp stamps a request-id before telemetry init, so when otel starts it uses the earlier value.

anjali: quick fix idea: during telemetry.init() check req.headers for x-request-id/request-id and stash it onto the raw request object (e.g., req._rw_orig_request_id) so any later reconcile prefers that value. add a unit test that simulates early middleware that mutates headers and then calls telemetry.init().

liam: low-risk and measurable. add a metric telemetry.requestid.reconciled with a tag for hostname so we can see how often reconciliation happens in hosted. include a changelog entry about "preserve existing request-id across init paths".

maria: temporary workaround i used: require('redwood-telemetry').init({forceSync:true}) at top of server.js and keep log level = info for onboarding scripts. that keeps ids consistent but loses richer debug hooks for new users. not great.

anjali: i'll open a small patch: 1) on init read headers, 2) set context key if present, 3) when creating spans prefer context value, 4) add test and changelog. cc @liam for review.

infra-bot: staging-deploy-bot scheduled: redeploy sampleapp-staging at 2026-03-03T14:00Z to validate fix.

maria: added issue #4522 with a minimal repro gist and assigned to @anjali. i'll validate on staging after deploy. thanks :thumbsup:
